name: Duotone
description: The scene behind the window is blurred and then remapped onto a two-colour gradient by brightness, for the concert-poster look. The darkest parts of the scene take the first colour and the brightest take the second. It shows through wherever the window itself is translucent, and the Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the gradient.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene behind the window is blurred (px). Past a display scale of 125% the top of the range stops adding blur, and the lowest setting is already a soft blur rather than none

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the pane (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the duotone backdrop

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: How sharply brightness splits between the two colours, where 1.0 is a linear blend. This is a gamma exponent and not the Contrast the other Blur packs carry. Raising it pushes the pane toward the first colour rather than widening the range

parameters.name: Shadow colour
parameters.description: Colour the darkest parts of the scene map to

parameters.name: Highlight colour
parameters.description: Colour the brightest parts of the scene map to

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. The whole chain follows one answer, so the bottom corners are all rounded or all square.

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper.

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: Fine grain over the two-colour map that hides banding in its gradient
